note: Triennial election of Kilkeel rural district council, one member for each of nineteen divisions; nominations received by Mr. J. J. Bell, clerk of the union, on 4 May 1927. Fifteen divisions were filled without a contest (in Rostrevor the only other nomination was invalid); Dunnaman, Glasdrumman, Kilkeel North and Maghera were polled on Thursday 2 June 1927. The News-Letter reports the new council as ten Unionists and nine Nationalists. Sole nomination; elected without a contest. The Newry Telegraph prints 'Hugh Brennan'. Returned unopposed.
